BROOKFIELD, Conn., Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Photronics, Inc. (Nasdaq: PLAB), a worldwide leader in photomask technologies and solutions, is scheduled to announce financial results for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, before the market opens.


The post[Photronics to Report Fiscal Fourth Quarter 2026 Results on December 9, 2026](https://photronicsinc.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/photronics-report-fiscal-fourth-quarter-2026-results-december-9) appeared first on[Photronics Inc](https://www.photronics.com/) .
